```{r setup}
library("hlebuhanec.0325")
library("GimmeMyStats")
library("GimmeMyPlot")
library("RColorBrewer")
library("rlist")
library("ggrepel")
library("kableExtra")
library("cowplot")
data("clinic2")

path_fig <- file.path(getwd(),  knitr::opts_chunk$get("fig.path"))
```

```{r}
table(clinic2$groupe) %>%
```

# Demography
```{r}
p <- list.map(
  unique(clinic2$groupe),
  f(x) ~ {
    res <- filter(clinic2, groupe == x) %>%
    filter(!is.na(age), !is.na(sexe)) %>%
    age_pyramid("age", "sexe", seq(0, 100, 10), colour = brewer.pal(4, "Paired")[3:4]) + 
    ggtitle(x) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))
  plot(res)
  }
)

list.map(
  c("age", "age_au_dg_an"),
  f(x, y) ~ {
    res <- clinic2 %>%
  select(all_of(c(x, "groupe", "patient")))
    if (y == 2)
      res <- filter(res, groupe != "HD")
  pivot_wider(res, names_from = groupe, values_from = !!sym(x)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("patient") %>%
  plot_violin(
    colour = palette_discrete()[seq(length(unique(res$groupe)))],
    cex = 1.2,
    pch_size = 3,
    pch_alpha = 0.25,
    coef = 1.5,
    breaks = c(25, 50, 75),
    label = TRUE,
    title = ifelse(y < 2, "Age", "Age at diagnostic")
  )
  }
)

p <- list.map(
  c("age", "age_au_dg_an"),
    f(x, y) ~ {
      if (y == 2)
      res <- filter(clinic2, groupe != "HD") 
      else
        res <- clinic2
      res %>%
    group_by(groupe) %>%
    summarise(print_numeric(!!sym(x))) %>% 
    select(-c("Variables", "Kurtosis", "Skewness", "Normality"))
    }
  )
p

list.map(
  c("age", "age_au_dg_an"),
  f(x) ~kable0(p[[x]]) %>%
  save_kable(file = file.path(path_fig, paste0("stats_", x, ".png")), zoom = 2)
)

filter(clinic2, is.na(age)) %>% 
  select(patient)

filter(clinic2, is.na(age_au_dg_an)) %>% 
    filter(groupe != "HD") %>%
    select(patient)
```

```{r}
list.map(
  find_dates(clinic2),
  f(x, y) ~{
    if (y != 2){
      regex <- "%Y-%m"
    } else {
      regex <- "%Y"
    }
    pull(clinic2, x) %>%
      plot_date(
        func2 = ymd, 
        title = str_replace_all(x, "_", " ") %>% str_to_sentence(),
        regex = regex
      )
  }
)
```

```{r}
list.map(
  unique(clinic2$groupe),
  f(i) ~ {
    res <- filter(clinic2, groupe == i)
  list.map(
    find_dates(res),
    f(x, y) ~{
      if (y != 2){
        regex <- "%Y-%m"
      } else {
        regex <- "%Y"
      }
      pull(res, x) %>%
        plot_date(
          func2 = ymd, 
          title = paste(i, ":", str_replace_all(x, "_", " ") %>% str_to_sentence()),
          regex = regex
        )
    }
  )
  }
)
```
```{r}
p <- list.map(
  find_dates(clinic2)[-5],
  f(x, y) ~ {
clinic2 %>%
    mutate(
    years = pull(., x) %>% 
        year() %>% as.character()
)  %>%
    select(years, groupe) %>%
    plot_bar_2cat(
        sort = c("HD", "DA", "PN"),
        stats = FALSE,
        title = str_replace_all(x, "_", " ") %>% str_to_sentence()
    ) -> res
    plot(res)
  }
)
```

```{r}
p <- list.map(
  find_dates(clinic2)[-5],
  f(x, y) ~ {
    print(x)
    if(y %in% c(3, 4)) {
      res <- filter(clinic2, groupe != "HD")
    } else {
      res <- clinic2
    }
    if (y == 1) {
      res <- res %>%
      mutate(
        days = pull(., all_of(x)) %>% 
        difftime(Sys.Date(), .) %>% 
        as.numeric()
        ) 
    } else {
      res <- res %>%
      mutate(
        days = pull(., all_of(x)) %>% 
        difftime(pull(res, "date_inclusion"), ., units = "days") %>% 
        as.numeric()
        )
    }
    select(res, days, groupe, patient) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = groupe, values_from = days) %>%
    column_to_rownames("patient") %>%
    plot_violin(
      colour = palette_discrete()[seq(length(unique(pull(res, "groupe"))))],
      cex = 1.2,
      pch_size = 3,
      pch_alpha = 0.25,
      coef = 1.5,
      label = TRUE,
      width_text = 20,
      title = str_replace_all(x, "_", " ") %>% str_to_sentence(),
      func_label = label_date,
      ratio_labs = 1
    ) -> res
    plot(res)
  }
)
```

### Errors in age
```{r}
clinic2 %>%
    mutate(
        age_years = as.numeric(difftime(date_inclusion, date_naissance, units = "days")) / 365.25
    ) %>% 
    mutate(diff_age = age_years - age) %>% 
    column_to_rownames("patient") -> res
select(res, diff_age) %>%
    plot_violin(label = TRUE)
filter(res, abs(diff_age)  > 1.5) %>% select(date_naissance, age_years, age, diff_age) %>% kable0(digits = 1)
```

## Biologic
```{r}
list.map(
  c("pne_mm3", "pnn", "monocytes", "cd4_micro_l", "cd8_micro_l", "ly_b_micro_l", "plaquettes", "creatinine", str_subset(colnames(clinic2), "ig_")),
  f(x) ~ {
    res <- clinic2 %>%
      select(all_of(c(x, "groupe", "patient"))) %>%
      filter(groupe != "HD")
    all_na <- res %>%
    group_by(groupe) %>%
    summarise(all_na = all(is.na(!!sym(x)))) %>%
    pull(all_na) %>%
      any()
    if(!all_na)
    pivot_wider(res, names_from = groupe, values_from = !!sym(x)) %>%
      column_to_rownames("patient") %>%
      plot_violin(
        colour = palette_discrete()[seq(length(unique(res$groupe)))],
        cex = 1.2,
        pch_size = 3,
        pch_alpha = 0.25,
        coef = 1.5,
        label = TRUE,
        title = str_replace_all(x, "_", " ") %>%
          str_to_upper() %>%
          str_replace_all("MICRO L", "\\(ml\\)") %>%
          str_replace_all("MM3", "\\(mm3\\)") %>%
          str_replace_all("IG", "Ig")
      )
  }
)
```

## Scores
```{r}
list.map(
  c("dlqi", str_subset(colnames(clinic2), "eva_")),
  f(x, y) ~ {
    print(y)
    clinic2 %>%
      select(all_of(c(x, "groupe", "patient"))) %>%
      filter(groupe != "HD") %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = groupe, values_from = !!sym(x)) %>%
      column_to_rownames("patient") %>%
      plot_violin(
        colour = palette_discrete()[seq(2)],
        cex = 1.2,
        pch_size = 3,
        pch_alpha = 0.25,
        coef = 1.5,
        label = TRUE,
        title = str_replace_all(x, "_", " ") %>%
          str_to_upper() %>%
          str_replace_all("POST TTT", "post-traitement") %>%
          str_replace_all("PRURIT", "prurit")
      )
  }
) %>%
    plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 3)

list.map(
  str_subset(colnames(clinic2), "easi_"),
  f(x, y) ~ {
    clinic2 %>%
      select(all_of(c(x, "groupe", "patient"))) %>%
      filter(groupe == "DA") %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = groupe, values_from = !!sym(x)) %>%
      column_to_rownames("patient") %>%
      plot_violin(
        colour = palette_discrete()[2],
        cex = 1.2,
        pch_size = 3,
        pch_alpha = 0.25,
        coef = 1.5,
        label = TRUE,
        title = str_replace_all(x, "_", " ") %>%
          str_to_upper() %>%
          str_replace_all("POST TTT", "post-traitement")
      )
  }
) %>%
    plot_grid(plotlist = .)

list.map(
    str_subset(colnames(clinic2), "iga_"),
    f(x, y) ~ {
        p <- mutate(clinic2, Group = !!sym(x)) %>%
            select(Group, groupe) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ as.character(.))) %>%
            filter(groupe != "HD") %>%
            plot_bar_2cat(
                sort = c("DA", "PN"),
                colour = brewer.pal(6, "Reds")[-1],
                colour_text = "black",
                legend = clinic2$iga_da %>% levels(),
                stats = FALSE,
                threshold_pct = 15,
                threshold = 1,
                width_title = 20,
                title = str_replace_all(x, "_", " ") %>%
                  str_to_upper() %>%
                  str_replace_all("POST TTT", "post-traitement")
            )
                if(y != 2)
                  p + theme(legend.position = "none")
                else
                  p
    }
) %>%
    plot_grid(plotlist = ., rel_widths = c(2, 2.75, 2))


x <- "sc_atteinte_percent"
clinic2 %>%
  mutate(clinic2, Group = !!sym(x)) %>%
  select(Group, groupe) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ as.character(.))) %>%
  plot_bar_2cat(
    sort = c("DA", "PN"),
    colour = brewer.pal(6, "Reds")[-1],
    colour_text = "black",
    legend = pull(clinic2, x) %>% levels(),
    stats = FALSE,
    threshold_pct = 15,
    threshold = 1,
    width_title = 20,
    title = str_replace_all(x, "_", " ") %>% 
      str_to_sentence() %>% 
      str_replace_all("percent", "\\(%\\)")
)
```

```{r}
name_levels <- levels(clinic2$nb_nodules_pn)
list.map(
   str_subset(colnames(clinic2), "nb_nodules_"),
    f(x) ~ {
        mutate(clinic2, Group = !!sym(x)) %>%
            filter(groupe == "PN") %>%
            pull(Group) %>%
      plot_pie(

        title = str_replace_all(x, "_", " ") %>% str_to_sentence() %>%str_replace_all("pn", "PN")
    )
    }
   
) %>%
    plot_grid(plotlist = ., nrow = 2, align = "hv")
```
